about_the_game:
Build, manage, and grow – one villager at a time.
In Tenfold, you take full control over a team of hardworking villagers. Each one can be commanded individually: assign tasks, position them precisely, and make sure they’re doing exactly what your settlement needs.

Venture out to gather resources – chop trees, mine valuable ores, and collect materials for crafting. Construct new facilities, improve your production lines, and keep your storage stocked. As your village expands, your villagers level up their skills – and with equipment upgrades, they’ll work faster, hit harder, and operate more efficiently.

You set the pace. Whether you prefer to micromanage every villager or focus on the bigger picture, the choice is yours. Every decision – from upgrading a simple axe to placing your next building – shapes the future of your settlement.

Key Features

  • Direct control: Select villagers individually and send them to exact locations or interactable objects.

  • Skills & upgrades: Level up mining, woodcutting, and crafting, and improve tools and gear.

  • Realistic resource management: Keep track of inventories, avoid downtime, and maintain constant production.

  • Build & expand: Unlock new structures to grow and optimize your settlement.

  • Tactical positioning: Place villagers smartly around resources for maximum efficiency.

In Tenfold, it’s all about growth, efficiency, and smart decision-making. Whether you’re chasing the perfect resource loop or simply building your dream settlement – the choice is yours.

name: Tenfold

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: 3Ghz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible, ATI, Nvidia or Intel HD
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: 4Ghz or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible, ATI, Nvidia or Intel HD
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible sound card

short_description: Tenfold lets you build the ultimate village: command your villagers, gather resources, upgrade skills and equipment, and create a thriving settlement that never stands still.
